metadata.purpose: Canonical structured database draft for WPBNewConstruction.com, updated with additional planning/watchlist research for Fern & Gardenia, Rybovich Marina Redevelopment, Rosewood Residences, 15 CityPlace, Fort Partners South Flagler, and Portofino/Flagler Yacht Club.
source_hierarchy: wpb-canonical-decision-import-plan-v2.md governs inclusion/exclusion, page grouping, pipeline/completed-comp treatment, and public-address rule.
agent2_conflict_resolution_report.md governs public-facing values vs municipal/legal notes where conflicts exist.
wpb-new-construction-research-handoff-v5-agent1-agent3.md supplies detailed project facts, amenities, teams, source URLs, and holes.
deep-research-report.md supplies missing-project research for Rosewood, Banyan Tree, Marina Redevelopment, and 10 CityPlace.
User-supplied missing planning projects research patch supplies additional planning/watchlist candidates and market-context holds.
rules: Use public-facing addresses on website pages.
Preserve legal/municipal/parcel conflicts as internal/source notes.
Forté on Flagler and La Clara are included as Completed Luxury Comps with Completed Comp badges.

Rosewood Residences West Palm Beach and Marina Redevelopment remain excluded/hold-for-review until official residential evidence is found.
10 CityPlace remains excluded from condo inventory; no public condo/context section for now unless Brooke later creates an office/demand-driver layer.
Fern & Gardenia / Related Ross Fern Street, Rybovich Marina Redevelopment, and Rosewood Residences West Palm Beach are added as public pipeline/watchlist records.
15 CityPlace remains excluded from condo inventory as office/retail only.
Fort Partners South Flagler / Harbor Towers and Portofino / Flagler Yacht Club remain internal hold-for-review records until filed residential plans exist.
